slot.intent: What they said, set against what they did.

concept: One claim builds at the centre; the pivot word lands, folds into a dashed seam that splits the frame, and the second claim builds opposite, the same red mark on both verbs.
storyboard: From the first word the claim builds at the centre, word by word in heavy sentence case, grey settling to off white
1.7 s, on "said,": said lands with a flat red highlighter sweeping behind it in the same stroke
2.1 s: the marked claim slides aside into its half in one soft move, leaving the middle clear
2.6 s, on "against": the pivot rises into the cleared space in off white, just under the line in 16:9, at the middle in 9:16
3.0 s: against closes from both ends to a sliver at its centre, and the dashed seam grows out of the sliver across the frame
3.4 s, on "what": the second claim builds opposite at the same gap from the seam, as the first steps back to mid grey with its red mark kept; did lands with the same sweep at 5.1 s

leansOn.title: Chapter title (this channel's approved version)
leansOn.why: Words build grey to off white as spoken, and one flat red highlighter sweep marks the key word as it lands.
